items.title: Mrs. Mary Lucy Hamill O'Kelly Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: one band I remember in New Orleans was Piron's band. Played very well.

ctx.x: All right, first of all, this is being recorded in Paschus Jan, April 4th, 1958. May the 4th, darling. May the 4th, 1958. Getting mixed up to start off with. All right, now, first I'd like you to tell your name, your birthplace, your date, when you lived in New Orleans, and so on, and which you... And then we'll start off on memories of jazz.

Well, this is Mrs. Mary Lucy Hamer O'Carrie. Born Mary Lucy Hamer in 1876 at Fixford, Mississippi. Lived after my marriage in 1900 at Ashwood, Louisiana, on the plantations that my husband came to New Orleans in 1909. Built a home there and lived in New Orleans until 1940. When I came to Paschus Jan to leave it. I was going home there. And I can't remember when. I first viewed jazz as being jazz. I just thought it was sort of embroidery that the niggers put on tunes that they played. They were not embedded as…
